checks: Daily periods use Japan midnight and each metric uses its actual event date
Completed ratio excludes ongoing rides and waiting time uses boarding records
Time utilization unions overlaps per vehicle and counts only elapsed operating windows
Current assignment and occupancy have different explicit denominators
No schedule means no invented time utilization
No vehicles or no finished rides produce unavailable ratios rather than fictitious percentages
Unknown or malformed hours never create a denominator
Future operating windows have no elapsed availability
Overnight windows clip to the selected local day
Missing terminal timestamps are excluded, never replaced by the snapshot clock
Daily totals, route rankings and request hours reconcile with the summary
Snapshot limits are disclosed when the record cap is reached
Itinerary excludes pending, completed and other vehicles and drops off onboard passengers first
Navigator destinations are allowlisted demo coordinates, never personal or arbitrary text
Disjoint and nested busy intervals never double count
